name: chase_melee
about: Chase: a hostile melee Troika human (a baseball bat, no firearm) with the player in sight ~983 cm away. After SCHED_TROIKA_START_COMBAT 0xea, CNPC_VHumanCombatant's weapon split (0x103872d0: the active weapon's word & 0x18000) takes slot 604 CNPC_VHuman::SelectScheduleMeleeCombat 0x10385e40 (shape.md). Slot 599 0x102b5650 admits melee (the can-enter timer past, no ranged weapon, height diff <= 64, the attack coordinator granting) and sets m_bInMelee; the in-melee tail with the player far (TOO_FAR_FOR_MELEE 0x09) reaches 0x102a11d0 -> the circle, or the plain advance. The NPC is bat-only, so slot 308 HasUsableRangedWeapon 0x10336d70 is false and the selector answers the _NR forms (CNPC_VHumanCombatant::SelectSchedule 0x103872d0 -> slot 604 CNPC_VHuman::SelectScheduleMeleeCombat 0x10385e40; stories/v4/packets-S3.md item 8): in reach (CAN_MELEE_ATTACK1 0x51) 0xdd SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ATTACK1_NR (line 0x65d) -> MELEE_ATTACK1_SWING 0xde -> TASK_MELEE_ATTACK1; out of reach (0x09 / 0x60) 0xcb SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_ADVANCE_NR (line 0x6b0), 0xd2 the approach inside 100 units without 0x51 (line 0x6bb), 0xe1 the circle. 0xdc / 0xca / 0xe0 are the forms of an NPC that also carries a usable ranged weapon. One SCHED_TROIKA_MELEE_IDLE (0xc7) first is retail: the selection that admits the NPC to melee has gathered no band word yet, so no `never` here forbids a single MELEE_IDLE after START_COMBAT. The melee band is the weapon's slot 367 (0x103eac30 -> 0x103ea7e0, walked in stories/v4/packets-S2.md item 4), not the NPC's slot 555. sched_troika_melee_advance(_nr).sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE MELEE_IDLE, SET_SPECIAL_DISTANCE_ACCUM DIST:COMBATMOVE, ADD_SPECIAL_DISTANCE_ACCUM_RND -64, SET_TOLERANCE_DISTANCE DIST:ACCUM, TASK_GET_PATH_TO_ENEMY, SET_INTERRUPT_TIME 2, ADD_RANDOM_INTERRUPT_TIME 1, RUN_PATH, WAIT_FOR_MOVEMENT; interrupts include CAN_MELEE_ATTACK1 and INTERRUPT_TIME, so the approach is re-selected every 2-3 s until the player is inside melee range (CAN_MELEE_ATTACK1 0x51) and the tail answers the in-reach attack. The spine: a path goal toward the player, the NPC arriving inside melee range, the melee attack selected. V4c: 0x103e9e00 -> slot331 0x10347180 -> slot311 0x10272400 commits a nonzero-rate kernel swing; AutoMovement 0x10280a50 -> 0x10094b70 -> 0x102e0bd0 carries its lunge.
